steps.content: Following the scavengers' guidance, you advance through the carnival ruins in search of the dragon, when suddenly you feel your clothes being tugged.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: There's danger ahead... Something very dangerous.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, maybe we should... take a detour?
Uncharacteristically, Yanyan looks frightened.
You scan the surroundings. Aside from the wind making the amusement rides creak, there doesn't seem to be anything out of the ordinary.
The FAC soldiers nearby launch their scanning devices. Moments later, they still detect nothing unusual.
You take Yanyan's hand and continue walking forward.
But you've barely taken one step when Yanyan screams and clings to your waist like a sloth, then continues to mutter something.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Arghhh! Celestial soldiers from the heavens! I beg your protection…
You think Yanyan has seen something spooky. During a casual chat with Du Ruo, she mentioned that some Easterners with strong psychic power can see things other people cannot.
If they can see things that exist beyond the physical world, then maybe Yanyan too...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: There's... there's Kaiming Beasts ahead!
That's not what you were expecting. Another term you don't know. You can only exchange confused looks with the FAC soldiers next to you.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: That thing is about the size of a tiger, and... it has many heads and always stands facing east... It's the scariest calamitous creature!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...Those things up on the platform. Look! They're turning in a circle! Sob...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You really are terrified of them, are you?

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Yan... Yanyan is not scared! A great seer wouldn't be scared of these monsters!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Just that this... this is an exception...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: That cursed dragon must have looked into my background. It knows I was scared to tears by stories of the Kaiming Beast when I was little... That's why it's targeting me like this!
Yanyan trembles uncontrollably behind you while babbling incoherently, like a child scared by the first ghost story she's heard.

steps.speaker: Scavenger A
steps.content: Hey, isn't that a carousel? This is the first time I've seen a child spooked out by a carousel.
The scavenger says behind you. You gaze at the so-called calamitous creature according to Yanyan, but it turns out to be only a carousel, the horses spinning in a circle in the wind.
As for the many heads... It's probably just the overlapped image of several abandoned horse rides.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...Carousel?
Yanyan articulates the word carefully.

steps.speaker: Scavenger A
steps.content: Little girl, have you never been on a carousel before? Oh dear... A child your age should be playing in the amusement park all day!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I have always been moving homes since my earliest memories, because of droughts or floods... Today is the first time I've heard of carousels and amusement parks.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...Did Yanyan say something wrong? Why are you so quiet?
Yanyan looks at the scavenger curiously. Not expecting such a response, he doesn't know what to say for a moment.

steps.speaker: Scavenger A
steps.content: Sorry, kiddo, I shouldn't have said that. You see, it happens at my age. This amusement park has been abandoned for many years due to the Black Ring. Somehow, I thought everyone remembered it...

steps.speaker: Scavenger A
steps.content: But the Black Ring was eliminated two years ago, so maybe it can be rebuilt.
The elderly scavenger looks toward the dilapidated amusement park, sighing.
Amusement parks and carousels are things found only in DisCity, in the center of the world. It's impossible for those caught in the disasters in Sunsink City a few years ago to have experienced them.
Children from Sunsink City have probably never even heard of an amusement park.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I'm sure they can rebuild it!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Seven years ago, Sunset Town was completely destroyed by the Sun Crow Apostle. But no one gave up, and a few years later, we built Sunsink City, which was brand new and even bigger.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: So I'm sure you guys can do it too!

steps.speaker: Scavenger A
steps.content: Haha... Well said, kiddo! If it gets rebuilt, you must come to play again!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Sure, Yanyan will be here! I'll make sure to have a great time!
While the old man and the young girl are chatting exuberantly, Corruptors begin charging toward you again.
You examine the monsters before you carefully. They are massive and extremely menacing. You've never encountered such species in DisCity over the past two years.
For some reason, every time after a few attacks, they'll emit a faint golden glow and freeze for a moment before shaking their heads and charging again.
It's as if they're fighting against something for control of their bodies. With no time to dwell on this, you quickly tell the scavengers to leave, then hurriedly command the FAC soldiers to fight.
